rules: Organizer sources preferred; official tourism listing clearly labelled where used.
Course assets explicitly labelled 2026 are not treated as 2027 GPX.
Published OpenRunner elevation figures are recorded as organizer-displayed D+, not independent binary validation.
No elevation is inferred where source does not provide it.
Audit-only: no live app event data or runtime files changed.

events.name: 42nd Wizz Air Budapest Half Marathon
events.detail: Organizer confirms 5 September 2027, 08:00, individual half marathon 21.1km. 10km, duo and trio formats are listed as forthcoming. AIMS also lists the 42nd edition on this date. No 2027 GPX or ascent figure verified.

events.name: Tartu City Marathon
events.detail: Visit Estonia event listing gives 2 October 2027, location Tartu and 42km/21km/10km options, plus city route description. This is a tourism authority listing rather than the organizer's detailed rules. No 2027 route metrics or GPX validated.

events.name: HOKA Semi de Paris
events.detail: Organizer FAQ explicitly confirms Sunday 7 March 2027. The same FAQ says 2027 course, start and finish details will be published later. No elevation or GPX yet.

events.name: Abalone Marathon de Nantes
events.detail: Official organizer page confirms 45th edition on 24–25 April 2027 and separate race times/distances. Elevation figures are published as D+ from OpenRunner (55m/115m/235m), not independently GPX-parsed. Marathon and half share start at Machines de l'Île and finish at Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire.

events.name: Run In Lyon by Harmonie Mutuelle
events.detail: Organizer confirms 3 October 2027 and registration open for marathon, half marathon, 10km and charity run. The course page explicitly says the displayed route downloads are 2026 routes; do not use them as 2027 routes/GPX.

events.name: Semi de Cannes

routes.status: official measured 2027 course; course preview and elevation pending

events.detail: Official 2027 rules confirm 21 February, 33rd half marathon, 27th 10km and 7th 5km. All three courses are officially measured; half marathon has FFA Gold label. Course preview and start time are still pending; organizer course page currently shows no elevation value.

events.name: Maasmarathon
events.detail: Organizer confirms Sunday 2 May 2027. Marathon route is two loops, flat and cross-border through Belgian and Dutch countryside along the Meuse; start/finish Place Reine Astrid at 09:00. Half marathon joins marathoners on the second loop. No numeric ascent or 2027 GPX binary verified.

events.name: Wizz Air Cluj-Napoca Marathon
events.detail: Official 2027 regulations confirm event weekend 10–11 April, marathon and half marathon starts on Sunday at Cluj Arena. Marathon route page has a route download control and detailed street route, but no 2027 GPX binary was downloaded or parsed in this audit.

events.name: Egmond Halve Marathon
events.detail: Organizer states the 52nd edition takes place Sunday 10 January 2027 (second Sunday of January). Official programme page still displays 2026 timetable. Third-party route analysis estimates about 67m ascent and describes beach, dune reserve and Bloedweg sections; this is not an organizer-published 2027 GPX metric. No official GPX found.

events.name: NN CPC Loop Den Haag
events.detail: Organizer confirms 51st edition on Sunday 14 March 2027; half marathon 21.1km, 10km, 5km and youth races listed. Event-info page describes a fast course; no 2027 GPX binary or elevation profile validated.
